decisions.summary: Founder rulings, binding and not reopened. Verbatim in plan section 3.1.

Execution directive: single integration branch integration/skill-ultra-126 with one PR to main reserved for founder merge; supersedes planner ruling PR-8 (per-unit PRs to main). Centralized independent reviewer: ~/.pi/agent/bin/pi-reviewer (or Pi native reviewer), Terra High, no silent fallback.

decisions.problem: Repo permits only squash merges (allow_merge_commit=false). Squash-merging unit PRs into the integration branch would collapse unit commits, which the directive says must not lose unit-level evidence.
options: Local git merge --no-ff of the reviewed unit HEAD, pushed to the integration branch (no ruleset on that branch)
decisions.selected: Local git merge --no-ff of the Terra-reviewed unit HEAD into integration/skill-ultra-126, then push. GitHub marks the unit PR merged because its commits are in base. Unit branches are never deleted.
decisions.reason: Preserves every unit commit, its review trail and handoff; no force-push; ruleset only governs main.
decisions.authority: Directive section 6 (internal integration merges authorized; do not squash away unit evidence)
decisions.terra: included in each unit review and the final integration review
decisions.risk: The final integration PR to main will still be squashed by the main ruleset at founder merge; the integration branch keeps full history.

decisions.problem: PR-8 also said the campaign tool stays unregistered in the bundled MCP until U3, to keep each main merge inert.
options: Drop the gate since nothing reaches main until founder merge
decisions.selected: Keep the U1 server-option gate until U3 exactly as the plan's U1/U3 briefs specify.
decisions.reason: The gate is part of the approved unit briefs, costs nothing, and keeps intermediate integration states inert.

decisions.problem: Parallel lanes in one checkout would collide; main checkout has unrelated uncommitted founder files.
options: One git worktree per lane under ~/skill-heaven-wt/
decisions.selected: One git worktree per lane under ~/skill-heaven-wt/<lane>; the founder's main checkout is never touched.
decisions.reason: File-ownership isolation; P3-style respect for the founder's working tree.
decisions.risk: Each worktree needs its own npm ci.
